verdict.rationale: Cursor ships an official, documented CLI (`agent`) for running AI agents from the terminal. It supports headless print mode for scripts and CI, machine-readable JSON and stream-JSON output, ACP over stdio JSON-RPC, a GitHub Actions recipe, configurable permission tokens, and API-key or service-account authentication. missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of CLI usage and reliability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Cursor CLI lets you interact with AI agents directly from your terminal to write, review, and modify code.
Use print mode for non-interactive scenarios like scripts, CI pipelines, or automation
Use Cursor CLI in GitHub Actions and other CI/CD systems to automate development tasks.
You can run agent acp and connect a custom client over stdio using JSON-RPC.
structured formats for programmatic use (`json`, `stream-json`) and a simplified text format
